verdict.rationale: Granola Chat lets users ask natural-language questions about their meetings and run follow-up workflows from chat, such as drafting and sending emails and Slack messages and creating Google Calendar events. Recipes save reusable prompts, and the MCP server lets external assistants like Claude and ChatGPT query notes in natural language. Missing for 10: evidence that core app functions (folders, sharing, settings, templates) can be controlled through natural language, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the chat workflows.
